how: The saltire request recruits help for work already in progress rather than initiating an empty canvas.
The later invitation recruits participation in an ongoing contribution through an image, Discord, and coordinates.
Explaining cooperation and supplying an example make a drawing invitation intelligible before any joining is demonstrated.
A dismissive clarification question can receive an explanation rather than a commitment to place.
A saltire request supplies a national picture proposal without establishing an adopted design or its original maker.
The crude alternative instantiates only an unanswered member proposal within the design element's minimal range.
An alternative suggestion cannot establish collective design adoption without evidence that others took it up.
The invitation reports that an ongoing contribution is progressing well without documenting every part built.
Anchor coordinates locate an already progressing saltire for prospective helpers.
A coordinate link locates the later contribution without establishing continuity with the earlier saltire.
A participant reports removing stray colours over days and handing the watch onward.
Ending a watch while encouraging continuing work marks a handoff without demonstrating an assigned shift system.
A participant reports a successful truce while leaving its terms, negotiators, and enforcement unseen.
The organiser reports help from a kindred subreddit without documenting a bargain or a response to exhausted hands.
Drawing a crude picture on something fits proposed playful alteration without proving execution or a named target.
Positive progress reporting and a participant's account of five hours mark ongoing involvement before closure.
An image link shares a view of ongoing work without proving final preservation or the work's eventual fate.
Fake civic works and replies identifying, rating, and extending April Fools jokes establish play alongside the canvas.
A dismissive request for explanation establishes host boundary-setting only if its words regulate or evaluate canvas talk.
An invitation followed by reports of prior work cannot establish that recruitment caused that work.
Replies seeking and supplying clarification cannot count as bare joins without evidence of commitment.
A crude alternative following a drawing call establishes a suggestion sequence rather than recruited hands attacking a rival.

statement: routing participation through a chat invitation
how: A chat invitation alongside coordinates supplies a route into ongoing work while its decisions remain outside the host thread.
Requests concerning existing work do not identify its first maker or prove others joined that maker.
Calling for help and explaining cooperation do not establish a judgement that available hands are insufficient.
Visible cooperation and a watch handoff cannot decide whether unseen chat decisions appointed leaders or divided work.
Reports of watching and hours spent leave scripts, spare accounts, and their necessity unobserved.
Naming stray colours does not identify the people who changed them or their motives.
A reported truce does not itself document restraint, apology, or sparing a neighbour's work.
Outside help and a Discord invitation do not establish a coalition or joint governance.
Different coordinates do not establish loss and relocation without continuity between the two works.
The truce report does not show a host granting space or ruling on another group's work.
The reported truce leaves any envoy and the route of negotiation unobserved.
Approving a reported truce does not establish a dispute about who may commit the room.
A generic crude suggestion and a truce report do not establish a pre-existing quarrel.
A national picture proposal does not establish arguments about belonging or ideology beyond the flag.
The generic alternative names no inherited tie and no rival targeted because of it.
The clarification exchange supplies no explicit rule, containment request, or judgement about the canvas's worth.
An invitation to ongoing work does not establish a successor project or a lasting institution.
Pre-close participation reports leave post-close contests over the canvas's preserved version unobserved.
The crude alternative does not document an exchange of taunts or claims with a rival.
Clarification and reports of prior participation do not establish a bare new commitment in response to a call.
A request concerning an already progressing work cannot identify a starter-to-call sequence.
The watch predates its written report, so posting order cannot establish a building-to-upkeep transition.
Watching and a truce occur in one account without establishing that erosion caused negotiation.
The reported truce provides neither its terms nor evidence that it subsequently produced restraint.
Reported upkeep does not establish escalation into machine placement or whether such escalation was needed.
Positive reporting and labour accounts do not establish completion causing collective celebration.
A positive update and image link in one invitation do not establish celebration causing preservation.
A shared image leaves any transition from recording the work to a successor effort untestable.
The two locations do not establish insufficient hands causing relocation of one continuous work.
Coordinates are present without evidence that design argument produced a settling template.
An early help report and later watch account do not establish strain causing an appeal to other rooms.
Separate help and truce reports do not establish negotiation opening a channel for traded assistance.
The crude suggestion has no documented reply establishing restraint as its consequence.
The separate truce report does not establish negotiation responding to the crude suggestion.
A generic suggestion leaves the development of a named rival contest untestable.
Upkeep and a chat invitation do not establish threat causing coalition formation.
Invitations do not establish a flood of canvas posts or a resulting host boundary.
A truce report and unseen chat cannot establish whether agreement produced a dispute over authority.
